About LIPI SOFT

We build technology that earns its place in the working day.

LIPI SOFT is a software and technology solutions company. We help businesses run more smoothly by connecting their systems, automating repetitive work and building software around the way they operate.

Technology projects tend to go wrong for ordinary reasons: the problem was never properly understood, the new system did not fit the old ones, or nobody planned for what happens after launch.

We set up LIPI SOFT to work differently. We begin with how your business runs today, recommend only what will make a real difference, and stay involved once it is in use. Our work spans AI automation, custom software, CRM, and networking and IT infrastructure, because real business problems rarely respect the boundaries between them.

Mission

Our mission

To build practical technology that removes friction from everyday work, so the people in a business can spend their time on what they are good at.

Vision

Our vision

A working world in which business systems are understandable, connected and dependable, and where adopting new technology feels like relief, not disruption.

Core values

What we hold ourselves to.

  1. 01

    Clarity before code

    We make sure we understand the problem, and can explain it back to you, before we propose anything. A clear brief is the cheapest part of a project to get right.

  2. 02

    Honest scope

    We say what we will do, what we will not, and what we do not know yet. If a simpler or cheaper route exists, including one that does not involve us, we point to it.

  3. 03

    Built to be handed over

    We document as we go and choose widely used technologies, so the system can be run and extended by your team or anyone you appoint.

  4. 04

    People stay in charge

    Automation should support judgement, not replace accountability. We design systems so that a person can always see what happened and step in.

  5. 05

    Steady, visible progress

    We work in short cycles and show real results at the end of each. You should never have to wonder what is being done or how far along it is.

Our approach

How we solve business problems.

  1. 1

    Start with the work, not the tool

    We watch how the process runs today and talk to the people doing it. Technology choices come after that, and follow from it.

  2. 2

    Solve the smallest useful problem first

    A narrow first release that people actually use teaches more than a broad specification. We grow the system from something that already works.

  3. 3

    Connect before replacing

    Existing systems hold years of data and habit. We look for ways to integrate and extend before recommending anything is thrown away.

  4. 4

    Measure, then improve

    We agree what to track at the outset, so decisions about what to build next rest on evidence.

Engineering and delivery

Careful work, shown early and often.

Good engineering is mostly discipline: small steps, honest reviews and a habit of leaving things clearer than we found them.

Readable over clever

Code is read far more often than it is written. We favour straightforward solutions that the next engineer can follow.

Tested where it matters

Automated tests cover the logic the business depends on, and releases run through a repeatable pipeline.

Secure by default

Least-privilege access, validated input and managed secrets are starting assumptions, not later additions.

Documented as built

Architecture notes, setup instructions and decisions are recorded alongside the code, and kept current.
